messages:
Alex (AE): Quick presales thread for VaultBank POC. They want to validate three things: long-document QA (targeting ~100k tokens per case), high-precision embeddings + rerank for regulatory Qs, and reliable tool-calls into their trade blotter API. Need to align success criteria, timing, and security asks.

Mira (SE): Heads up: we can't stream a single 100k context in one model call. Recommend chunk+embed+rerank approach. Use 32k or 64k model variants and sliding window for continuity. KV cache can help for follow-ups.

Jordan (Solutions Eng): For rerank/embeddings: what metric does the customer care about? precision@1 or recall@5? Also need initial QPS to size infra.

Alex (AE): They want a single top answer to be correct most of the time (precision focused). Estimate ~4k queries/day with EOD spikes. Budget-conscious; open to a reserved monthly commit if pilot shows perf.

Sam (Security): They'll send an infosec questionnaire. Must confirm SOC2 status and whether we can support customer-managed KMS. Also flag: no PII in logs, and audit trail for tool calls.

Mira (SE): Proposed success criteria (draft):
- Factual accuracy (top-1) >= 90% on a 200-sample regulatory prompt set
- Rerank: precision@1 >= 0.86 and MRR >= 0.80 on labeled QA pairs
- Latency: p95 <= 400ms for single-turn QA on Dedicated pool
- Inference cost target: pilot avg < $0.02 / 1k tokens processed

Jordan (Solutions Eng): Suggested timeline:
- Day 0: scoping + security questionnaire
- Day 1-7: ingest dataset, chunking + build embedding index (FAISS/HNSW)
- Day 8-14: run rerank baseline + cross-encoder fine-tune (if needed)
- Day 15-21: closed evaluation with their 200 prompts + traffic mirroring
We can compress if they accept fewer prompts or synthetic data.

Mira (SE): Example eval flow we'll hand them:

````
INPUT: long filing (up to 100k tokens)
STEP 1: chunk -> embed -> candidate retrieval (top 100)
STEP 2: cross-encoder rerank -> return top-1
EVAL: compare to gold label using normalized F1 + human spot-check
````

Jordan (Solutions Eng): Also propose regression guardrails: canary vs baseline diff in top-1 accuracy <= 2% before any rollout.

Priya (Legal): I'll prep DPA redlines and vendor terms. If they push for on-prem, procurement timelines could add 6-8 weeks. Flagging now.

Sam (Security): Question for SE: for Private deployment, can embeddings and indices remain entirely inside their VPC? They want to avoid any outbound index replication.

Mira (SE): Yes — Private/VPC option supports customer-managed index and no data egress. Hosted mode stores embeddings in our managed index unless customer elects Private indexing. We'll document KMS integration and encryption-in-transit details.

Alex (AE): Pricing options to present: 1) 4-week hosted pilot (metered) -> upgrade to Dedicated reserved capacity if targets met; 2) Private deployment (longer lead, infra + license). I'll draft numbers post-perf run.

Jordan (Solutions Eng): Blockers to call out early to the customer:
- 100k-context expectation -> must accept chunking tradeoffs and evaluation criteria
- Embeddings privacy -> hosted vs private index decision
- Tool-calls auth -> need service account, allowlist, and rate limits defined

Alex (AE): Action items:
- Mira: tech runbook with chunking pattern, sample eval harness, and a small synthetic dataset (deliver EOD Thu)
- Jordan: cost sketch for ~4k QPS/day and Dedicated sizing (deliver Mon)
- Sam: security questionnaire template + KMS bullet points (deliver Tue)
- Priya: DPA redline start + on-prem timeline note (deliver Wed)

Mira (SE): I'll include a tiny replayable demo (docker + sample index) so they can validate quickly.

Alex (AE): I'll schedule 30m with VaultBank on Thursday to confirm success metrics and collect sample prompts. Thanks all. :rocket:
